attests.affects_why: a certificate is affected by a change in its subject
attests.note: the five subject dimensions live in the certificate body

calls.affects_why: a caller is affected by a change in its callee
calls.note: a dynamic path such as cases/${id}/${action} must be declared in the UI sidecar

checked_by.affects_why: evidence is affected by a change in its checker pin

conforms_to.affects_why: a conformance claim is affected by a change in the model
conforms_to.note: CONFORMS_BOUNDED; own status, own bounds, printed abstraction losses

contains.affects_why: a container depends on its parts; parts do not depend on the container (no sibling fan-out)

signatures.note: the reflexion mapping module to component is a function

covers.affects_why: a test is affected by a change in the code it executes
covers.note: coverage is not fault detection; the mutation lane attaches fault_detection_permille with a tool pin (integer, no floats)

decides.affects_why: a human decision is void when its subject digest changes
decides.note: humans only; the only act that clears SUSPECT or approves a statement digest; a decision whose subject is an edge names its edge id in attrs.subject

defeats.affects_why: an unresolved defeater blocks its parent claim

depends_on.affects_why: a dependent is affected by a change in its dependency
depends_on.note: dynamic imports are invisible: heuristic wherever extraction is syntactic; the transition rows carry the kernel's role, guards, required and forbidden effects

derived_from.affects_why: a generated artefact is stale when its source changes
derived_from.note: GENERATED label; the kernel re-runs the generator and byte-compares; the from anchor detects hand edits

documents.affects_why: a document is stale when what it describes changes (the OKF STALE rule)

exercised_by.affects_why: a test is affected by a change in what it exercises

exposes.affects_why: an operation's behaviour is defined by its handler

flows_to.affects_why: control flow: an upstream state or transition affects what follows
flows_to.note: bipartite: state to transition to state; the kernel already rejects dangling transition states

signatures.note: a transition has exactly one source state
a transition has exactly one target state

formalises.affects_why: a formal statement is affected by a change in the intent it formalises
formalises.note: human-reviewed fidelity of the statement; specification quality is the weak point

models.affects_why: a model is affected by a change in what it models
models.note: a proof about a model is not a proof about the code

motivates.affects_why: an ADR is a historical record; later change supersedes it rather than invalidating it

names.affects_why: a surface is affected by a change in its term; the term's binding by a rename of the surface
names.note: merges the ui dossier labels edge; qualifier is the surface; bindings are declared, not inferred

proposes.note: proposal only; cannot satisfy a gate or clear a link

proves.affects_why: a witness is affected by a change in the statement it proves
proves.note: valid only with a pinned statement, an assumption ledger and a second check

realises.affects_why: a realisation is affected by a change in its concept; the concept's realisation status by a change in the realisation

refines.affects_why: a refinement is affected by a change in what it refines
refines.note: term to term is SKOS broader (child refines parent); formal_model to formal_model is abstraction refinement

renamed_to.affects_why: a rename record is applied by resolution, not by impact

signatures.note: from may be absent from the graph (tombstone); path-level form: an edge between two module ids moves the whole file

satisfies.affects_why: an implementation is affected by a change in its requirement; the requirement's satisfaction is affected by a change in the implementation

serves.affects_why: a journey or requirement is affected by a change in its persona

styled_by.affects_why: a UI node is affected by a change in its token

supersedes.affects_why: supersession is reported by a rule over documents links

supports.affects_why: a claim is affected by a change in its support

verifies.affects_why: a verifier is affected by a change in what it verifies; the verified thing's evidence is affected by a change in the verifier
verifies.note: a model check that verifies a requirement carries the label CHECKED_BOUNDED; a model proof is not a code proof

adr.note: a fragment names one decision inside a log file such as ADR-001 inside 0000-poc-decision-log.md (the okf lane has 14 such pages)

document.note: a fragment names a table row (md-table-row-v1); the okf lane's Verification Technique pages map here

symbol.sysml_v2: EIJA-specific (class to part def is a PREDICTION)

test.note: a fragment names one test function (ast-v1); without a fragment the node is a whole test or smoke file (lf-sha256-v1), which is how the acceptance matrix cites evidence today
